title: Zerobox Profile
description: A named preset of sandbox permissions with optional inheritance.

extends.description: Base profile(s) to inherit from. Child values override base values.

deny_read.description: Block reading from these paths. Takes precedence over allow_read.

allow_write.description: Allow writing to these paths. Supports $HOME, $CWD, $TMPDIR templates.

deny_write.description: Block writing to these paths. Takes precedence over allow_write.

allow_net.description: Allow network to these domains. Empty array = allow all network.

deny_net.description: Block network to these domains. Takes precedence over allow_net.

set_env.description: Set environment variables in the sandbox.

secret_hosts.description: Map secret names to allowed hosts. Values are passed at runtime via --secret, never stored in profiles.

allow_all.description: Grant all filesystem and network permissions.

strict_sandbox.description: Require full sandbox (bubblewrap). Fail instead of falling back to weaker isolation.

restore.description: Restore tracked files to pre-execution state after exit.

snapshot_paths.description: Paths to track for snapshots. Supports $HOME, $CWD, $TMPDIR templates.

debug.description: Show sandbox configuration and runtime decisions on stderr.
